en.title: Truth or Chug
en.description: Pick a number, take the challenge, or drink.
rules: Mark the number when it has been taken if you want to keep track.
If someone says the same number, they have to chug.
If you do not do the challenge, drink 5 sips and the challenge stays open for others.
If you do the challenge, everyone drinks 2 sips.
The trick is to remember the numbers that have been said so you avoid chugging.
